@graph.name: SolarSurges SCADA Platform
@graph.description: The SolarSurges SCADA platform is a cloud-based monitoring and control system that centralizes fleet-wide visibility, predictive analytics, fault alerting, and mobile O&M for utility-scale and distributed PV plants. It is used to manage 30+ plants across China with an average 8.7 percent yield gain versus fixed-tilt.

mainEntity.name: What is cloud-based SCADA for distributed PV?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloud-based SCADA for distributed PV is a centralized monitoring and control platform that aggregates data from geographically separated PV plants into a single fleet-wide dashboard. It eliminates the need for on-site IT infrastructure at each plant and supports predictive analytics, mobile O&M, and remote fault diagnostics from any browser or mobile device.

mainEntity.name: How does the SolarSurges SCADA position against hardware-centric monitoring solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: SolarSurges SCADA is purpose-built for utility-scale plants with 100 MW plus capacity and integrates natively with the SolarSurges TCU and NCU. It focuses on fleet-wide visibility, predictive analytics, and mobile O&M delivered as a vendor-neutral software platform through open protocols.

mainEntity.name: Can SolarSurges SCADA integrate with third-party inverters and meters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. SolarSurges SCADA integrates with Sungrow, Huawei, Sineng, FIMER, SMA, and other major inverters via Modbus TCP and IEC 60870-5-104. Revenue-grade meters, weather stations, and pyranometers are supported through the same open protocol framework.

mainEntity.name: Is SolarSurges SCADA available as a mobile app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. SolarSurges SCADA includes native iOS and Android apps for O&M teams, with offline mode for sites with intermittent connectivity and push-to-talk coordination between field technicians and the central control room.
